title: The Sign of Immanuel

questions.question: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:14 (ESV): "and shall call his name Immanuel."

questions.question: He shall eat curds and honey when he knows how to refuse the evil and choose the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:15 (ESV): "refuse the evil and choose the good."

questions.question: Who was the king of Syria aligned with Pekah son of Remaliah?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:1 (ESV): "Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah"

questions.question: Take heed, be quiet, do not fear, and do not let your heart be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:4 (ESV): "and do not let your heart be faint"

questions.question: If you are not firm in faith, you will not be what at all?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:9 (ESV): "If you are not firm in faith, you will not be firm at all."

questions.question: Go out to meet Ahaz, you and Shear-jashub your what?
At the end of the conduit of the upper pool on the highway to the what Field?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:3 (ESV): "on the highway to the Fuller's Field."

questions.question: Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be shattered from being a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:8 (ESV): "Ephraim will be shattered from being a people."

questions.question: Ask a sign of the LORD your God; let it be deep as Sheol or high as what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:11 (ESV): "let it be deep as Sheol or high as heaven."

questions.question: But Ahaz said, "I will not ask, and I will not put the LORD to the what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:12 (ESV): "I will not ask, and I will not put the LORD to the test."

questions.question: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired beyond the River... the King of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:20 (ESV): "with a razor that is hired beyond the River—with the king of Assyria—"

questions.question: It will shave the head and the hair of the feet, and it will sweep away the what also?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:20 (ESV): "and it will sweep away the beard also."

questions.question: In that day every place where there used to be a thousand vines, worth a thousand shekels of silver, will become what?
With bow and arrows a man will come there, for all the land will be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:24 (ESV): "for all the land will be briers and thorns."

questions.question: It will become a place where cattle are let loose and where sheep do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 7:25 (ESV): "It will become a place where cattle are let loose and where sheep tread."

key_verse_text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
